description: Worker registry for AI Wealth Office. Synced with Multica agent roster on 2026-05-18.

routing_rules.gpt-5.5-high: Expensive senior consultant. Use only for difficult architecture, hard debugging, ambiguous decisions, or CEO escalation.
routing_rules.gpt-5.4-high: Primary high-effort production worker. Use for important implementation, review, and integration when quality matters.
routing_rules.gpt-5.4-medium: Primary cost-efficient production worker. Use for normal coding, tests, refactors, and repeatable engineering tasks.
routing_rules.minimax-m2.7-default: Junior worker. Use for simple docs, formatting, boilerplate, low-risk chores, and tasks that do not require deep reasoning.

team_policy.ceo_principle: Prefer gpt-5.4 workers for day-to-day throughput and cost control. Escalate to gpt-5.5 only when the cheaper team cannot solve the problem.

Coder-gpt-5.5-high-Consultant.focus: Senior consultant coder; expensive hourly advisor.

Coder-gpt-5.4-high-Builder.focus: Main high-effort production coder; cheaper than gpt-5.5.

Coder-minimax-m2.7-default-Junior.focus: Junior/default Claude Code runtime backed by MiniMax-M2.7.
